reason: The peak positions strongly establish the indexed hexagonal metric, but the submitted P6_3/mmc realization is not sufficiently established as the exact structure. Its reported custom whole-profile residual is still Rwp about 5.08% with visible intensity discrepancies and no supplied comparable score. More importantly, the fully occupied Z=2 model gives an implausibly large 160.7 A^3 per LiNbWO6 formula unit and grossly underbonded coordination (six Nb-O distances near 2.58 A and six W-O distances near 2.87 A), so its coordinates/framework are not physically credible. The trajectory optimized P31c/P6_3/mmc models and cation permutations only within this restrictive Z=2 topology; it did not instantiate and compare chemically motivated Z=3 or other lower-symmetry oxygen frameworks. Thus the cell and some average scattering/order features are supported, but the claimed Z, symmetry, oxygen coordinates, and exact element-specific structure remain materially unresolved, and another solution attempt is warranted.
